types1:Item.types1:Name: ErrorAlert_Process
types1:Item.types1:Description: Build guide 4.13-4.14. Shared fault handler target: notifies on any failed employee run.

process.name: ErrorAlert_Process

parameter.name: XRefCode
parameter.description: Employee identifier the failure occurred for, empty if the failure happened before an employee was resolved (e.g. GetChangedEmployees itself)

parameter.name: FailedStepName
parameter.description: Name of the sub-process/step that raised the fault

parameter.name: HttpStatus
parameter.description: HTTP status code from the failing call, if available

process.description: Build guide 4.13/4.14: receives structured fault details from the Orchestrator's fault handler scope and sends a notification. Recipient list and per-record vs. digest format are still open per the design doc and must be confirmed with the client (build guide 4.14).
process.notes: Hand-authored against the CPD-Dayforce Functional Design & API Build Guide v1.0 - see README_IICS_BUILD_NOTES.md for schema caveats. The "notify" step below is written as a generic Email Notification action per build guide 4.14 ("Add an Email Notification step, or use IICS's native notification connector") - swap in whichever the client confirms. OPEN ITEM: recipient list and per-record vs. digest format need client sign-off before production use; per-record (one email per failed employee) is used here as the safer default until a digest is explicitly requested, since a digest risks batching failures and delaying awareness.

notify.title: Send error notification
notify.description: OPEN ITEM: recipient list TBD (build guide 4.14). Subject/body below use the fault fields captured by the Orchestrator's fault handler.
notify.subject: Dayforce-CPD integration failure: XRefCode {XRefCode} at {FailedStepName}
